providers.description: List of allowed OpenID Provider configurations. Each item must contain issuer_uri, client_id, and expiration fields as defined in the items schema below.

policy_rules.description: List of access policy rules. Each item defines who can login as which local principal, optionally restricted to a specific provider.

providers_items.description: Schema for individual provider entries in the providers list. Note: This is a helper for the list items, not a top-level variable, but included here for schema completeness if the engine supported recursive schemas. Since we use flat map for items: {issuer_uri: string, client_id: string, expiration: string}. The actual schema for the list items is implicit in the template usage of provider.issuer_uri, etc. However, per instructions, for a list-of-objects, add items as a FLAT map field-name -> {type, default, description}. So we define the fields of the objects inside the list here.

providers_items.issuer_uri.description: The Issuer URI of the OpenID Provider (e.g., https://accounts.google.com).

providers_items.client_id.description: The Client-ID (audience claim) in the ID Token.

providers_items.expiration.description: Expiration policy for user's SSH public key. Options: 12h, 24h, 48h.

policy_rules.principal.description: The local system user account that can be logged into (e.g., root, alice).

policy_rules.identity_spec.description: The identity specification to match. Can be an email (alice@example.com), a group (oidc:groups:ssh-users), or a custom claim (oidc:"https://acme.com/groups":ssh-users).

policy_rules.provider_issuer.description: Optional: The Issuer URI of the provider to restrict this rule to. If omitted, matches any defined provider.
